Class WebApplicationObjectSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.context.support.ApplicationObjectSupport
org.springframework.web.context.support.WebApplicationObjectSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, ApplicationContextAware, ServletContextAware
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractCachingViewResolver, AbstractHandlerMapping, AbstractView, BeanNameViewResolver, ContentNegotiatingViewResolver, ServerEndpointExporter, WebContentGenerator
public abstract class WebApplicationObjectSupport extends ApplicationObjectSupport implements ServletContextAware
Convenient superclass for application objects running in a WebApplicationContext. Provides getWebApplicationContext(), getServletContext(), and getTempDir() accessors.

注意：通常建议使用针对实际所需回调的独立回调接口。这个宽泛的基础类主要用于框架内部，因为在需要访问ServletContext等场景时通常会用到它。

Since:
28.08.2003
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • setServletContext

      public final void setServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext servletContext)
      描述从接口复制：ServletContextAware
      Set the ServletContext that this object runs in.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之前调用。在 `ApplicationContextAware` 的 `setApplicationContext` 之后调用。

      Specified by:
      `setServletContext` 接口 `ServletContextAware` 中
      Parameters:
      servletContext - 此对象将使用的 ServletContext 对象
      See Also:
      • InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()
      • ApplicationContextAware.setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)

    • initServletContext

      protected void initServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext servletContext)
      Subclasses may override this for custom initialization based on the ServletContext that this application object runs in.

      默认实现为空。由initApplicationContext(org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext)以及setServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext)调用。

      Parameters:
      servletContext - 此应用程序对象运行的 ServletContext（永远不会为 null）

    • getWebApplicationContext

      protected final @Nullable WebApplicationContext getWebApplicationContext() throws IllegalStateException
      Return the current application context as WebApplicationContext.

      注意： 仅在确实需要访问 WebApplicationContext 特定功能时才使用。最好使用getApplicationContext()或getServletContext()，以便在非 WebApplicationContext 环境中也能运行。

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - 如果未在 WebApplicationContext 中运行
      See Also:
      • ApplicationObjectSupport.getApplicationContext()
